Against.description: Which structure this one is built against, and on which side.

structure.description: The id of a building in this design.

anyOf.description: Joists sit on top of the beams and may run past them.

Joists hang in hangers between beams level with them, for a deck too
low for beams underneath.

The International Residential Code's prescriptive deck tables
(R507), with no local changes.

Fairfax County, Virginia's Typical Deck Details (2021 Virginia
Residential Code), which permit drawings there may follow.

DeckCode.description: A set of deck rules to check a deck against.

anyOf.description: Beams straight on concrete piers.
Beams on posts, each post on a concrete pier.
Beams on precast concrete deck blocks set on the ground.
Wood boards: 5/4 boards span 16", 2x boards 24".

Plastic or wood-plastic composite boards, which span what their
maker's listing says.

FloorSpec.description:
A floor platform on beams, covering the building's footprint. Joists
run front to back; beams and rim joists run along the front.

beam_plies.description:
Boards laminated into each beam, such as 2 for a doubled 2x8.
Default 1.

beams.description:
Beam lines, front to back, the outer two under the rims.
Default 2.

on_center.description: Joist spacing, on center. Defaults to the framing spacing.

pier_inset.description:
From each end of a beam to the center of its end pier.
Default 12".

pier_spacing.description: Most room between piers along a beam. Default 6'.

post.description: Post size, when the beams sit on posts. Default 4x4.

post_height.description:
Post length, pier top to beam bottom, when the beams sit on
posts. Default 12".

support.description: What the beams sit on. Default piers.

anyOf.description: Beams on piers; beam joints land on a pier.
Beams laid on grade as skids; no piers.
Beams on short posts, each post on a pier; beam joints land on a post.

FramingSpec.description: Framing conventions shared by every structure.

layout_from.description:
Which end of each wall the stud layout is measured from, seen
from outside. Default left.

on_center.description: Stud, joist and rafter spacing, on center. Default 16".

wall_lumber.description: Lumber size for wall studs and plates. Default 2x4.

anyOf.description:
Southern yellow pine, the usual pressure-treated and framing lumber
in the Southeast and Mid-Atlantic.
Spruce-pine-fir, the usual kiln-dried "SPF" stud and framing stock.

FramingSpecies.description:
Species of framing lumber in the code's joist and rafter span tables
(IRC R802.4.1), all No. 2 grade.

Length.description: A length in builder notation: feet with ', inches with ", fractions to the sixteenth, like "12'", "7' 3\"", "38-1/2\"" or "3/4\"".

Nominal.description: A nominal lumber size, thickness by width, like "2x6". 5/4 sizes are decking.

anyOf.description: A small penetration, such as a mini-split line set.

OpeningSpec.description:
A door, window or small penetration in a wall. Sizes are rough openings,
the framed hole.

header.description:
Header size over the opening. Default 2x8 for a door, 2x6 for a
window, 2x4 for a penetration. Sticks doesn't size headers yet.

height.description:
Rough opening height. Default 82-1/2" for a door, 36" for a window,
4" for a penetration.

place.description: Where it goes along the wall.

sill_height.description:
Bottom of the rough opening above the floor. Default 0" for a door,
44" for a window, 1' for a penetration.

width.description:
Rough opening width. Default 38-1/2" for a door (a 36" door slab),
36" for a window, 4" for a penetration.

Pitch.description: Roof pitch as inches of rise per 12" of run, written like "4:12" or "3-1/2:12". The rise is more than 0 and less than 24.

anyOf.description: Its left side `distance` from the wall's left end.
Its right side `distance` from the wall's right end.
Centered along the wall.

Place.description: Where an opening sits along its wall, seen from outside.

PorchDeckSpec.description:
A deck under a porch: joists hung from the building's floor rim out
to a beam on piers, with decking across them.

beam.description: Beam size, under the outer rim. Default 4x6.

decking.description: Decking boards, laid along the front. Default 5/4x6.

joist.description: Joist, rim and ledger size. Defaults to the floor's joists.

step_down.description:
How far the top of the decking sits below the subfloor.
Default 1".

PorchSide.description: The side of a building a porch can go on. Only the front for now.

anyOf.description: A single slope, high at the front wall and low at the back.

Two slopes meeting at a ridge that runs along the front, with the
gables over the side walls.

back_overhang.description: Level distance the rafters run past the back wall. Default 12".

ceiling.description:
Whether a ceiling is fastened to the underside of the rafters.
Default no.

collar_tie.description: Gable roofs: collar ties across rafter pairs. Default 2x4.

dead_psf.description:
Weight of the roof itself, pounds per square foot: 10 for
asphalt shingles or metal, 20 for heavier roofing. Default 10.

fascia.description: Fascia size. Defaults to two sizes up from the rafter.

front_overhang.description: Level distance the rafters run past the front wall. Default 12".

ground_snow_psf.description:
Ground snow load where it's built, pounds per square foot. Ask
the building department. Default 30.

kind.description:
Lean-to (one slope, high at the front) or gable (a ridge along
the front, gables over the side walls). Default lean-to.

on_center.description: Rafter spacing, on center. Defaults to the framing spacing.

ridge.description:
Gable roofs: the ridge board. Defaults to two sizes up from the
rafter.

species.description:
Species of the rafters, for the span tables. Default southern
pine.

Sheathing.description:
Sheathing on the outside walls and the roof. Leave a thickness out to skip
that part.

roof.description: Roof sheathing thickness, such as 1/2". Also covers the porch roof.

Side.description:
A side of a building. Front and back run along its width; left and right,
seen from outside the front, run along its depth.

SideWall.description: One of a building's four outside walls and what goes in it.

openings.description: Doors, windows and penetrations in this wall.

tees.description:
Centers of inside partitions that tee into this wall, measured from
its left end seen from outside.

anyOf.description: Douglas fir-larch, hem-fir and spruce-pine-fir, incised for treatment.
Redwood, western cedars, ponderosa pine and red pine.

Species.description: Wood species groups in the code's deck span tables.

anyOf.description:
A rectangular building, like a shed: four outside stud walls, on a
floor platform or not, under a roof or not.

depth.description: Outside to outside, front to back.

floor.description:
The floor platform the walls stand on. Leave it out when the walls
stand on a slab.

id.description: A short name other structures use to refer to it, like "shed".

roof.description: The roof. Leave it out for walls only.

sheathing.description:
Sheathing on the outside walls and roof. Leave it out, or leave out a
thickness, to skip that part.

walls.description:
Doors, windows and tees on the four outside walls. List a wall only
when something goes in it.

width.description: Outside to outside, along the front wall.

anyOf.description:
A covered porch across the front of a building: posts on piers, a
beam on the posts, and a roof hung from a ledger on the front wall.
It can have a deck under it.

beam_plies.description: Boards laminated into the beam. Default 2.

deck.description:
A deck under the porch roof, a step below the building's floor.
Leave it out for open ground.

depth.description:
From the front wall's outside face to the outside of the posts.
Default 6'.

id.description: A short name for it, like "porch".

ledger.description: Ledger size. Defaults to two sizes up from the rafter.

ledger_height.description:
Top of the ledger above the subfloor. Defaults to just under the
front wall's top plates.

overhang.description: Level distance the rafters run past the beam. Default 12".

pitch.description: Defaults to the building's roof pitch.

post_spacing.description: Most room between posts, center to center. Default 8'.

rafter.description: Rafter size. Defaults to the building's rafters.

anyOf.description: A deck standing on its own footings, away from any building.

beam_plies.description: Boards laminated into each beam. Default 2.

beam_style.description:
Whether the joists sit on the beams (under) or hang between them
level with them (flush, for a low deck). Default under.

beams.description:
Beam lines across the joists, the outer two near the ends.
Default 2.

code.description: Which deck rules to check against. Default the 2021 IRC.

decking.description: Decking boards, laid across the joists. Default 5/4x6.

decking_material.description: Wood or composite decking. Default wood.

depth.description: Along the joists, outside to outside.

frost_depth.description:
Local frost depth the footings go below. Ask the building
department.

height.description:
Ground to the top of the decking. Over 30" needs guards, which
Sticks doesn't draw yet.

id.description: A short name for it, like "deck".

live_psf.description: Live load, pounds per square foot. Default 40.

on_center.description: Joist spacing, on center. Defaults to the framing spacing.

overhang.description:
With beams under the joists: how far the joists run past the
outer beams. Default 0".

pier_above_grade.description: Pier tops above the ground. Default 2".

post.description: Post size, when the beams sit on posts. Default 4x4.

post_inset.description:
From each end of a beam to the center of its end support.
Default 12".

post_spacing.description:
Most room between supports along a beam. Defaults to the longest
span the code allows.

soil_psf.description:
Soil bearing pressure for footing sizes, pounds per square foot.
Default 1500.

species.description: Wood species group for the span tables. Default southern pine.

support.description: What the beams sit on. Default piers.

width.description: Along the beams, outside to outside.

anyOf.description:
A straight stud wall standing on its own, like a partition or a
garden wall.

height.description: Overall height, bottom of the bottom plate to top of the top plates.

id.description:
A short name for it, like "partition". Not front, back, left or right,
which name a building's walls.

left_end.description: What happens at the left end. Default plain.

right_end.description: What happens at the right end. Default plain.

tees.description: Centers of partitions that tee into this wall, from its left end.

Structure.description: One thing to build. `kind` says which, and picks the fields that follow.

Version.description: The schema version a design is written against.

anyOf.description: A single end stud: a free end, or a wall that butts into another.
This wall runs through a corner and backs the wall that butts into it.

WallEnd.description: What happens at one end of a wall.

description:
A design Sticks can frame and check for a permit: what gets built, and
the few framing conventions that apply to all of it. Say only what the
person asked for; anything left out takes Sticks' documented default and
is shown to them as an assumption.

name.description: What the person calls the project, like "Backyard shed".

questions.description:
Questions for the person about things the request left out that
change the permit or the structure, such as how tall it is or what it
stands on. Leave it empty when a default will do.

structures.description:
What gets built. Sticks frames at most one building, one porch on
that building, and one deck, plus any number of freestanding walls.

title: Sticks design
